title: Newton's Second Law: F = ma
summary: How force, mass and acceleration are linked, the newton, and why weight is W = mg.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 6: How Forces Affect Motion
Earlier NCERT: Force and Laws of Motion

objectives: I can use F = ma to calculate force, mass or acceleration.
I can describe an experiment to show a ∝ F and a ∝ 1/m.
I can calculate weight using W = mg.
misconceptions: A bigger force always means a bigger speed (rather than a bigger acceleration).
Mass and weight are the same thing.
The force in F = ma is any single force, not the resultant force.
